about_the_game:
Play the Pre-Alpha & Shape the Game! 🎮


Demo with a pre-alpha or preliminary version of the game, still in a very early stage of development. This game is being developed by a single person, so it’s common to encounter errors or incomplete elements while playing.

This demo primarily aims to showcase some of the game’s technical and gameplay aspects, as well as its potential, through a free exploration experience. The currently available gameplay features include:

Basic Tutorial: The player can complete a basic survival tutorial by following some simple missions.

Basic Survival System: The character can eat, drink, collect stones and wood, craft some tools, and even build a simple wooden base.

Basic Combat System: The character can engage in melee combat with an axe or pickaxe, as well as shoot firearms like a pistol, assault rifle, or shotgun.

Save & Load System: The player can save and load the game at any time.

Barter/Trading System: The character can trade with Bill, an in-game NPC, exchanging resources like wood or stone for weapons and ammunition.

Horse Riding: The character can ride a horse, allowing for much faster travel across the game world.

Pet Interaction: The player can interact and even play with Troki, the little Golden Retriever at the camp.

Open-World System: The player can freely explore the entire area designated for the demo, which includes mountains, forests, fields, a city, a port, and other locations.

I apologize for not having something more complete at the moment, but I will continue updating it as development progresses. Thank you very much for your understanding and patience! :)

content_descriptors.notes: Violence, blood, horror, undead and other photorealistic aberrations that could hurt your sensibilities.
